case: an asset inside a Metashape project: the psx:// locator
why: The twin of blend://. The project numbers its keys per type (model 2 and point_cloud 2 are two assets), so the type is in the locator. Percent-encoded like blend_locator, so a chunk label with a slash or a path with a space and an accent goes and comes back. The form is the one 3DSC for Metashape writes (dtc_stamp_ms.py) and s3Dgraphy's make_psx_locator produces: pinned here so the three cannot drift. A path on somebody's disk: private.
